title: CPF Module Schema: Private Endpoint Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-privateendpoint'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

group_ids.description: (Required) A list of subresource names which the Private Endpoint is able to connect to. subresource_names corresponds to group_id.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ip_configuration.type: map(object({ private_ip_address = string subresource_name = optional(string) member_name = optional(string) }))
ip_configuration.description: (Optional) An ip_configuration block as defined below map(object({ private_ip_address = "(Required) Specifies the static IP address within the private endpoint's subnet to be used. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." subresource_name = "(Optional) Specifies the subresource this IP address applies to." member_name = "(Optional) Specifies the member name this IP address applies to." }))

is_manual_connection.description: (Required) Does the Private Endpoint require Manual Approval from the remote resource owner? Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

private_connection_resource_alias.description: (Optional) The Service Alias of the Private Link Enabled Remote Resource which this Private Endpoint should be connected to. One of private_connection_resource_id or private_connection_resource_alias must be specified. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

private_connection_resource_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Private Link Enabled Remote Resource which this Private Endpoint should be connected to. One of `private_connection_resource_id` or `private_connection_resource_alias` must be specified. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

request_message.description: (Optional) A message passed to the owner of the remote resource when the private endpoint attempts to establish the connection to the remote resource. The provider allows a maximum request message length of `140` characters, however the request message maximum length is dependent on the service the private endpoint is connected to. Only valid if `is_manual_connection` is set to true.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

static_ip_required.description: (Required) Whether a Static IP is required to be assigned to Private Endpoint or not.

subnet_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Subnet from which Private IP Addresses will be allocated for this Private Endpoint. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

custom_dns_configs.description: The custom DNS configuartions name associated with the private_endpoint.

custom_network_interface_name.description: The custom network interface name associated with the private_endpoint.

id.description: The resource ID of the created Private Endpoint.

name.description: The name of the created Private Endpoint.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Privateendpoint' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
